skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the principles, methods, and processes of procurement, including bidding and tendering.
Apply project management principles to the planning and execution of procurement processes.
Ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements in procurement activities.
Manage contracts and contractual relationships effectively.
Negotiate effectively with suppliers and stakeholders.
Analyze and evaluate bids and proposals.
Communicate effectively with all parties involved in the procurement process.
Work effectively in teams and collaborate with others.
Identify and solve problems related to procurement.
Develop the ability to learn independently and continuously improve procurement knowledge.
